mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by >1% Y/Y, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows by >1pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by >10% Y/Y, it signals a demand-driven boom that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth > 10% but SPX 20-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth slows by >2% Y/Y, it signals a consumer-led demand slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y RSAFS growth slows by >2pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by >50k jobs M/M, it signals a labor market slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: M/M PAYEMS growth < -50k but SPX 5-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% Y/Y, it signals an inflation scare that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL Y/Y > 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.
